title: Trip-Level Amounts for Elementary and Middle School Competitors, UIL Travel Fee Schedule (Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees)
content:
Under the UIL travel fee schedule of **Student Activities, Athletics and Trip Fees**, a trip-level amount is added to the travel fee of a UIL Academic and Robotics Team participation for the 2026-27 school year whose registration date is after 2026-08-03: minus 40.00 for a participation at an elementary campus whose student's enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 02 through 05, minus 20.00 for a participation at a middle school campus whose student's enrollment record in status enrolled for the school year shows grade 06 through 08, and nothing otherwise.

The campus is the participation's campus, the campus whose program the student joins. Elementary campuses: Alder Springs Elementary, Bluebonnet Trail Elementary, Cypress Hollow Elementary, Live Oak Elementary, Pecan Grove Elementary. Middle school campuses: Hollis Middle School, Ridgecrest Middle School. The grade is the one on the student's enrollment record for the school year kept by Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions.

| Participation's campus | Grade on that enrollment record | Trip-level amount |
|---|---|---|
| elementary | 02 to 05 | minus 40.00 |
| elementary | other | nothing |
| middle school | 06 to 08 | minus 20.00 |
| middle school | other | nothing |
| high school or other | any | nothing |

Both conditions of a tier hold together or the tier does not apply; an enrolled grade outside a tier's range at that tier's campus level adds nothing.
